lines.text: The disciples ask who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven, and Jesus says whoever humbles himself like a little child.
Jesus says a person who causes a little one to stumble would be better off with a millstone around his neck, drowned in the sea.

wrong_details.wrong: a millstone around his neck, drowned in the sea
wrong_details.true: a large millstone hung around his neck and drowned in the depths of the sea

lines.text: Jesus says not to look down on little ones, because their angels in heaven always see His Father's face.
A man with a hundred sheep leaves the ninety-nine to search for one lost sheep, and he rejoices over it.
If your brother refuses to listen privately, take one or two others, then tell it to the priests.
